invariants.rationale: shapes is used throughout the method, so it is expected to be non-null at method exit.
If isTransform() is true, then transform methods must have been executed, implying their existence.
When isTransform() is true, drawDebugRects is always called.
If isTransform() and clip are true, transformations must be handled.
super.drawDebug(shapes) is called, indicating the superclass must exist.
